items.title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq slip ahead of pivotal week
items.take: Nvidia slipped about 2% after the Financial Times reported Jensen Huang and his allies are weighing a campaign to reinstate him as CEO, one week after the board forced him out. Tech led the tape lower, with the VIX jumping about 12% to 21.5.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow, S&P Live Updates for November 16, 2026
items.take: The tech selloff carried into the new week, with a chip gauge down 5% and the Nasdaq 100 off 2%. Bonds edged higher ahead of Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Monday remarks and tomorrow's Nvidia earnings.

items.title: Nvidia's first post-Jensen earnings and Anthropic's IPO: What to watch this week
items.take: Nvidia reports its first post-Huang quarter Tuesday after the close, with interim CEO Colette Kress helming the 5 p.m. call. Anthropic prices Wednesday and starts trading Thursday on the Nasdaq as ANT, and October retail sales plus the Fed minutes round out the calendar.

items.title: 5 Things Investors Need to Know About Monday's Markets
items.take: Bitcoin traded near $64,300, leaving November down roughly 17%, its second-worst start to a month since 2016. Crypto-linked stocks were under pressure premarket, with Strategy (MSTR) off 8%.

items.title: Sean Duffy Wants $50 Billion to Prevent More Travel Chaos
items.take: Travel chaos stretched into a third day after Friday's FAA ground stop, which the agency traced to a contractor replacing decades-old copper wire at remote sites in Arkansas and Texas. Duffy is asking Congress for $50 billion to modernize an air-traffic system he calls 'incredibly old.'
